faq.q: How do I book a seat?
faq.a: Send a request through the form on this page or call us on +381 63 417 063. Your seat is confirmed once the deposit of RSD 2,000 per person is paid to account 160-6000000762570-84 (Nikola Kovačević).

faq.q: How much does the evening cost?
faq.a: The five-course menu is RSD 7,900 per person. The RSD 2,000 deposit is paid in advance and the rest at the restaurant.

faq.q: What if I have an allergy or don't eat certain foods?
faq.a: Let us know when you book and we will check what the chef can adapt.
